title: Astronaut says the moon technology was destroyed

tellings.quote: >> I'd go to the moon in a nancond. The problem is we don't have the technology to do that anymore. We used to, but we uh destroyed that technology

plain: An unnamed NASA astronaut is heard saying he would go back to the moon "in a nanosecond", but "we don't have the technology to do that anymore. We used to, but we uh destroyed that technology." The clip comes up on Michels's show in a conversation about hidden power and secrets. Taken at face value, it suggests knowledge was deliberately lost.
